Related Reports

Specialty DRAM Price Sep. 2026

Consumer DRAM prices are approaching the limit of buyer cost tolerance, with recent contract prices settling slightly higher and the spread between high and low pricing narrowing somewhat. Looking ahead, as major suppliers reallocate capacity to advanced products, the supply of mature node memory will continue to contract; combined with strengthening demand for server storage components, the market supply deficit will persist, keeping prices elevated.
